name: ROTARY VACUUM EVAPORATOR
desc: Industrial-Scale Rotary Vacuum Evaporator engineered for high-efficiency solvent recovery and vacuum drying. Features a massive 100-liter processing capacity built with premium Borosilicate Glass components and a high-efficiency vertical condenser.
features: Massive 100 Liters multi-application storage layout (Pilot Plant Model)
Premium High-Grade Heavy-Wall Borosilicate Glass components
Heavy-Duty Vertical Condenser for optimum solvent recovery rates
Analog Micro-Adjustable Temperature Control interface (20°C to 180°C)
Dual independent over-temperature safety cutout protection devices

specifications.Equipment Configuration: Industrial-Scale Rotary Vacuum Evaporator Assembly (Pilot Plant Model)
specifications.Condenser Geometry Type: Heavy-Duty Vertical Condenser for optimum solvent recovery rates
specifications.Glass Hardware Construction: Premium High-Grade Heavy-Wall Borosilicate Glass components
specifications.Heating Bath Temp Range: Wide operational thermal control 20 to 180 Degree
specifications.Primary Process Mechanism: Thin film evaporation across large surface area via uniform heat transfer
specifications.Vacuum Performance Focus: Sealing systems engineered specifically for high continuous vacuum operations
specifications.Safety Integration Cutouts: Dual independent over-temperature safety cutout protection devices
specifications.Physical Safety Features: Heavy-duty protection hood for the oil/water heating bath and rotating flask
specifications.Target Field Applications: Vacuum drying of wet solids, degassing of liquids, and solvent recovery
specifications.Operational Versatility: Supports both batch and continuous extraction operations under pressure
specifications.Flask Customization Scope: Adaptable configuration supporting interchangeable evaporation flask volumes
specifications.Electrical Power Line: 220 V, 50-60 Hz Single Phase / Three Phase flexible industrial link
specifications.System Distillation Index: High distillation rates with maximum purity of distillate/recovered solvent
specifications.Warranty Cover Protection: 1 Year Comprehensive Manufacturer Warranty on full drive and bath framework
